## Summary

The bug was in `gunicorn/util.py` at line 436. The code had:

```python
if True:  # not callable(app):
    raise AppImportError("Application object must be callable.")
```

The condition was hardcoded to `if True:` instead of `if not callable(app):`, which caused the `import_app` function to always raise an `AppImportError` regardless of whether the application object was actually callable or not.

The fix was simply changing `if True:` to `if not callable(app):` so the check properly validates that the imported application is callable before returning it.
